description: React functional component 'NoteList' for rendering and managing a list of notes in a note-taking application, including search, selection, context menu, and interactions with Redux store.

methods.name: _updateSelectedNotes
methods.description: Dispatches an action to update the selected notes, toggling multi-select based on event meta key.

methods.name: _permanentlyEmptyTrash
methods.description: Dispatches an action to permanently delete all notes in the trash.

methods.name: _pruneNotes
methods.description: Dispatches an action to prune notes, likely cleaning up empty or draft notes.

methods.name: _updateActiveNote
methods.description: Dispatches an action to set the specified note as active, with multi-select option.

methods.name: _searchNotes
methods.description: Dispatches a search action with debounce to handle search input.

methods.name: handleDragStart
methods.description: Handles the drag start event for notes, setting data transfer with note ID.

methods.name: handleNoteOptionsClick
methods.description: Handles click events on note options, opening context menu based on click target.

methods.name: handleNoteRightClick
methods.description: Handles right-click events on notes, showing context menu with position set to cursor location.
